definitions.explanation: The hand on the left side of the body.
The left side when giving directions or describing locations.

examples.english: I write with my left hand.

examples.japanese: {左手|ひだりて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm holding the luggage in my left hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{左手|ひだりて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えます→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: If you go straight ahead, you'll see a bank on the left.

examples.japanese: {左手|ひだりて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怪我|けが}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I injured my left hand and can't use chopsticks.

notes:
{左手|ひだりて} means both "left hand" (the body part) and "left side" (when giving directions). The meaning is usually clear from context.

DIRECTION USAGE:
When giving directions, {左手|ひだりて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ means "on your left":
- {左手|ひだりて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: visible on the left
- {左手|ひだりて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: located on the left
This is a polite, natural way to give directions.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {左手|ひだりて}: left hand / left side
- ⟦{右手|みぎて}→右手：10438_migite⟧: right hand / right side

PRONUNCIATION:
The literary reading さしゅ exists but is rarely used in modern Japanese.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{左利|ひだりき}き→左利き：22396_hidarikiki⟧: left-handed
- ⟦{左側|ひだりがわ}→左側：22836_hidarigawa⟧: left side (more neutral than {左手|ひだりて} for directions)
- ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧: left (general direction word)
